Our test list groups parked cars and random encounters spotted during our playthrough of GTA 6. This second part adds the cars we found after the latest patch, checked on two consoles.

Pegassi Vitello

Villa garage on Flamingo Parkway, east of Belville.

Bravado Banshee

A red Bravado Banshee is parked in a villa garage on Starfish Island most nights, next to the jetty.

Drive across the causeway at night and check the garage on the north side of the island.
